problem:
A car salesman has sold the following quantities of a particular model of car in the last few weeks:

$$
3,\,5,\,6,\,8,\,5,\,3
$$

What is the mean of these figures?

feedback.problem:
What is the mean of the following data set?

$$
9,\,4,\,3,\,9,\,12,\,5,\,6,\,8
$$
feedback.worked_solution:
If we have a data set that consists of the points ${x}_{1},{x}_{2},…,{x}_{n},$ then the mean is denoted by $\overset{―}{x}$ and is given by the following formula:

$$
\overset{―}{x}=\frac{1}{n}{\sum }_{i=1}^{n}{x}_{i}
$$

Here, there are $n=8$ data points. Adding up all the points in the data set, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{\sum }_{i=1}^{5}{x}_{i} & =9+4+3+9+12+5+6+8 \\  & =56.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the mean is

$$
\begin{aligned}\overset{―}{x} & =\frac{1}{n}{\sum }_{i=1}^{n}{x}_{i} \\  & =\frac{1}{8}\cdot 56 \\  & =7.\end{aligned}
$$
